name: gomailserver Self-Hosted Mail Server
free_limit: AGPL-3.0 self-hosted mail server software; no software-enforced mailbox or message quota stated. Includes SMTP, IMAP, CalDAV and CardDAV; hosting and delivery resources not included.
watch_out: Requires own server, DNS, TLS, storage and outbound SMTP connectivity; VPS/provider fees and SMTP port restrictions may apply. AGPL-3.0 obligations apply to modified network deployments. Operational reliability and security require independent evaluation.
